title: karaoke timing manifest
description: Contract between build_karaoke.py and any reader. Version 1.0 documents all eight keys the builder emits; the prior published reference documented only `words` and `duration`.

schema_version.description: ADDED in 1.0. Absent in every manifest built before this schema; readers should assume 1.0 and warn.

words.description: Flat, ordered, non-overlapping word timings. The highlight loop reads only this.

sentences.description: Sentence spans. `match_rate` is the per-clip ASR agreement; below ~0.6 the sentence fell back to proportional timing.

blocks.description: Structural markdown blocks, in document order. `narrated: false` marks code fences, which are rendered but carry no timings.

turns.description: One entry per input file. A multi-turn reader segments on this.

source_text.description: The raw markdown the build consumed, verbatim. Hash this against the turn source to detect a stale artifact.

attribution.description: Provenance. `mode` is NOT self-knowable and must be supplied exactly or omitted. `tokens.input` is unobtainable locally and is null unless API-supplied.

qc.description: The build's self-report. `source_matches_ground_truth` absent means NOT CHECKED, which is not a pass.
